Letter read from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Both pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB decompressed. CSS stripped before parsing, letters read from each tier__tier block's tier__title, specs from each entry's img alt. All 80 letters byte-identical to stored - nothing merged; snapshots advanced to 2026-08-30 on tonight's fetch. Page self-dates read from the body's 'Last Updated' line: raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026 (the M+ list is bylined Tactyks, whose creator entry is raid-scoped for exactly that reason), both unchanged. Era-verified s2 from the body: the raid page says 'the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss' and the M+ page 'dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2'; neither mentions Season 1, and all 40 roster specs including Devourer matched on both. Method carries no published field in the registry, so these self-dates are recorded here rather than written into sources.json - adding a field is registry structure, not an agent-updatable value.

All 12 registered archon.gg pages were fetched individually with the full browser header set: every one returned HTTP 403 with a 5.8-5.9 KB Cloudflare body, <title>Just a moment...</title>, and __NEXT_DATA__ count 0. Upstream frozen for 19 days; both endpoints fetched fine, so this is not our transport. Two plain curls, no headers, no proxy, no auth: manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 161,191 bytes, returning Last-Modified 'Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT' - the two agree. Per the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest lesson the PAYLOAD was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelisting categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === 'lowerBound' AND keyRange undefined selects exactly 3 blocks = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, and all 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are identical to stored at the series' 1-dp stored precision. The melee/ranged blocks were excluded by whitelist rather than by blacklisting 'dungeon', since they are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs. Nothing to merge, so asOf correctly stays at the source's own 2026-08-11 snapshotDate and the coverage date does not move. The wowmeta.com HTML pages were NOT fetched (stale S3 prerender), so their registry snapshots were left alone. This is the owner-accepted standing red on the contract row - it clears when WoWMeta re-runs; do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays.

All three pages self-identify 'Midnight Season 2'. The coverage date is now 2 days old against maxAgeDays 5, so this is not yet a red.

HELD WHOLESALE for a fifth night - a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure - but coverage moved and the owner should know. All 27 DPS specs requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each: 22 returned real charts tonight against 19 on 08-29, and only 5 still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body - Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Retribution Paladin. Havoc, Arms and Fury have arrived since last night. Every one of the 22 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (ptr is the string "0", as documented) with chart timestamps 2026-08-29, advanced from 08-26, against 26 stored profiles all on MID1 at 2026-07-08/07-15. Adoption is still blocked, now on two grounds rather than three: SIM_TIER_REQUIRED plus the tier-uniformity invariant forbid a pool holding both MID1 and MID2, and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key and derives its ST/cleave/AoE labels as within-role percentiles, so a partial merge would publish WHICH specs upstream has re-simmed as if it were spec strength. The row-drop floor no longer blocks it: 22 of 26 is a 15% drop, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25. Merged NOTHING; stored fightProfile values, tiers and dates are byte-identical and the coverage date correctly stays 2026-07-08 rather than being re-stamped. FLAG FOR THE OWNER: the landing is now a wholesale MID2 adoption gated only on the remaining 5 specs plus a human value_move_ack - the value-move gate has no agent-writable proposal channel. Bloodmallet's missing 5 are exactly the 5 missing from SimC's MID2 report, so the two are converging together as the contract row predicts.

HELD for a fifth night; the blocker is unchanged from 08-29 (maxValueMovePct), but two upstream facts moved. (1) MID2_Raid.txt is 1.29 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-30T07:27:34Z, header '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-29/69497, git build HEAD 5f3ee6dba2)' - a new build against last night's f367d1aff1 - and its 'DPS Ranking:' block carries 41 profiles which map by LONGEST-PREFIX (hyphen allowed) to 22 of the 27 DPS roster specs, the same 22 as last night; the 5 absent are Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker and Retribution Paladin, and the 7 unmapped profiles are tanks. (2) MID1_Raid.txt has itself moved to 12.1: its header now reads the same 12.1.0.69497 build, so the 12.0.7 artefact this row has been anchored on is being re-run - but the file is 272 bytes, an in-progress log with no ranking block, and MID1_Raid.html is still Last-Modified 2026-08-08, so there is nothing to read from it yet. At 22 of 26 stored rows a wholesale adoption is a 15% drop, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25, so the row floor does not block. What blocks it is maxValueMovePct: all 22 overlapping rows move +69.3% to +135.1% (Frost DK 137,886 -> 233,408 at the low end, Fury Warrior 109,256 -> 256,864 at the high), and the value-move gate takes only a human value_move_ack or a reviewed local run. Merging only some of the 22 is separately forbidden: the name 'SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS' is season-agnostic and its ranks are pooled across the family, so leaving five 12.0.7 values standing beside twenty-two 12.1 ones would rank two patches against each other. Merged NOTHING; stored rows byte-identical at their 2026-08-08 coverage date.

MERGED 39 rows - the period matured. /period/latest HTTP 200, 198 KB, 302-resolving to period 1078, still week 2 of MID2, but the subtitle has moved: 10,000 characters (2,833 unique), 17.2 average key level against (3,384 unique) / 16.3 on 08-28, i.e. the rolling top-2000 pool has turned over into higher keys. Parse BOUNDED to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section, ending at the 'Classes and specs' heading; scanning the whole page instead picks up the classes block and the per-dungeon sections and yields the wrong chart under the right series name. Labels normalised across the lowercase-hyphenated form (devourer demon-hunter) and the value taken from the span AFTER the bar's height: style. Shape checks before merging: 39 rows, 0 unmatched, sum 100.2% with role subtotals DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.1 / Healer 19.9, and the page's own group headers agree (Ranged 30.3 / Melee 29.8 / Tank 20 / Healer 20) - so this is the representation SHARE column, not the /meta per-key-presence figure. 28 of the 39 values moved (largest: Arcane Mage 13.0 -> 12.0, Retribution Paladin 3.7 -> 3.2, Elemental Shaman 6.6 -> 7.2, Brewmaster Monk 1.1 -> 1.7); every value is under minValueMagnitude 100 so the value-move gate does not apply, and the family median moves 1.05 -> 1.3. Augmentation Evoker has RETURNED to the block (at 0.0) after being absent on 08-28; Frost Mage is still absent entirely, so its stored row stays untouched at value 0 / asOf 2026-08-27 and the family holds 40 rows. Merged asOf 2026-08-30 (the observation date; the page publishes no data date beyond the period id).

His 2026-08-22 whole-spec 'both' take was superseded by the pair, matching the Obli precedent. Devourer got NO take: the only mention is that Havoc/Devourer stats now roll into Vengeance, a gear remark and not a read, and the eleven other specs he names are him reading the tuning notes aloud, outside his registered scope. Yes,' / 'keys.') straddles a speaker-change marker and cannot be attributed, so it goes to skipped[] with that reasoning and his 08-26 Fury M+ take stands.
